interpretation_limits: Turn duration is not equivalent to active model computation.
Recorded MCP duration excludes shell commands, file changes, reasoning, queueing, hosted waits, and uninstrumented no-output intervals.
Inter-turn time after a completed response is not Agent execution and must not be counted as idle processing.
The broad governance workflow is not a like-for-like benchmark for the narrow v0.8.0 Release-body correction.
No token counts were available, so token waste is not quantified.
